The plan, once scheduling works, is a post titled "North morning digest" at 09:15 Chicago time each day. It would summarise the previous day in both channels. It would leave out DMs and finance figures.

Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials. Tell me when that's done and I'll set it up. Until then, I can post a digest here on request.
